name: task-finalize
purpose: Finalize one frozen task: insert a brief authored architecture note when needed, maintain maps, reuse fresh tests and verify acceptance in Python.
pre_prompt: Use workflow_test as the one-call shortcut. Supply architecture_note only for required new responsibilities/invariants/decisions, with optional architecture_title. Keep the note brief and factual. Python resolves hashes and scope, inserts the note without replacing existing prose, refreshes shadow/map and runs only frozen test commands. No preparatory map/hash lookup is required.
post_prompt: passed=true is native acceptance. Otherwise follow next_action and only repair listed failures. Passing tests with a missing note means finalize the note, not rewrite passing code. Full evidence remains in the session.
